description: This file contains extension methods for the Orleans testing framework, specifically for handling configuration and test cluster options within the Orleans.TestingHost namespace.

classes.name: TestClusterExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IHostBuilder and IConfiguration to facilitate testing cluster configuration in Orleans.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the IConfiguration object from an IHostBuilder, throws if not found.

methods.name: GetConfigurationValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific configuration value by key from an IHostBuilder.

methods.name: GetTestClusterOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the TestClusterOptions object from an IHostBuilder.

methods.name: GetTestClusterOptions
methods.description: Creates and returns a TestClusterOptions object by binding configuration data.
